_base.description: applies to every analyzer; the analyzers scope themselves by package path and file name

exclude_files.external/.*: third-party code is not ours to lint
exclude_files.bazel-out/.*: generated code (proto, ent, tools) is not hand-written
exclude_files.tools/lint/.*: the analyzers themselves are a separate module that make lint-custom does not lint either
exclude_files.tools/ci/.*: CI/build helper programs shell out to git, bazel and gh by design; they are not product code
exclude_files.tools/bzl/(manual-instance|merge-bazel-r: Bazel/build helper programs shell out to git, bazel and go by design; they are not product code (tools/bzl/nogo/testdata seeds stay linted so the seed checks can fail)
